I wont give it a negative recommend because it is free, but it is a pretty weak game....Position matters with one character, the lumberjack who is the second character....All the others, it doesn't matter if they are in back row or front, it is the same exact DPS number...Also was tearing through the mobs like a hot knife thru butter...just way too easy, no challenge whatsoever....and the UI is a mess...When I got a chest I had to click in several spots and several times just to open it....There are several other idlers like this one and they are done much better.

Really fun game to play! Got all achievements after a bit less than a year while just running it in the background and mainly focusing on events and not achievements while playing. Perfect game if you just want something fun for inbetween.
Support also answered me within a week, even though the game is sunset, and was very helpful and polite!
One of the OG idle games and still the best one out there. Nothing else comes close to this depth.‍
The satisfaction of watching monsters explode into gold coins is something I didnt know I needed.‍
Server is finally down. Or ???
ok
An semi-idle game that masterfully commands your obsession. Your time turns into primary currency rewaring hours of tactical formation-tweaking with deeply satisfying endress parade of progression.

How did I spent 3K hours on this game? Where did time go by? 
Great idle game, funny and snarky missions, very addicting, can run on a toaster, but it's on "Sunset" mode, so I guess we'll never get another update ever again.
I cant explain why, but moving cartoon characters around a grid is incredibly compelling gameplay.‍
Im not usually into these games but this one grabbed me. The formation puzzle is compelling.‍
There is always something to do. Missions, events, campaigns, resetting. Never a dull moment.‍
I just got a legendary item for my favorite crusader and I screamed. My neighbors hate me now.‍
Great community and developers who actually listen to feedback. Rare these days.‍
This game respects your time. You can play actively or idly and still progress.‍
If you have OCD about completing collections, this game will destroy you. In a good way.‍
I love the holiday events. Halloween and Christmas are always a blast.‍
A must-play for fans of the genre. It defines what a modern idle RPG should be.‍
I started playing this as a joke and now I have 5000 hours logged. Send help or send more idols.‍
I spent way too much time arranging my crusaders to get that extra 1% DPS. No regrets.‍
Played this back on kongregate, glad to see it on steam. Still just as good.‍
Good for casual play but also has depth for hardcore min-maxers. Best of both worlds.‍
It is refreshing to play a clicker where strategy is more important than just clicking fast.‍

I really enjoyed 100%ing the achievements. Even with the servers sunset, everything remains fully achievable. The progression loop starts slow, but once you unlock stronger characters, things scale exponentially—just expect the journey to take longer than you think.

At some point, you’ll probably be tempted to spend money to speed things up, but honestly, it isn’t worth it. The time savings seem helpful in the moment, but once you’re finished, you’ll realize it made almost no real difference. The grind itself is what carries the experience. Truly a masterpiece

neg.text:
Strangely addicting, even if it is a pretty poor example of a good game. It's a fairly standard formation building incremental game, and by "fairly standard" I mean it does nothing to innovate on the genre.

You have your guys, they have abilities, you kill monsters for gold to level up your guys and get their abilities so you can kill stronger monsters. Reset at certain milestones for prestige currency to do it all again faster.

There are a lot of big problems with this game though, the biggest being balance. Events are structured in a "tier" system with each tier providing at least one character. You need to complete the tiers in full and in order, which is really tedious when higher tier characters are deliberately designed to be strictly better than lower tiers. You have to grind through a bunch of objectives for a character you'll never use because their only ability is increas

Extremely forgettable idle game with predatory monetization and zero payoff. Not worth your time, even for free.

I was cleaning up my Steam library and found this game and genuinely didn’t remember playing it. Turns out I have 200+ hours and a bunch of achievements, which says everything. It’s an idle game, so most of that time is just letting it run, but unlike other idle games I’ve played, this one is painfully bland. Progress is slow, and resets feel unrewarding.  On top of that, it’s loaded with microtransactions and FOMO junk that constantly nags you to spend money. The whole thing just exists to waste time and money. There’s no story, no payoff, and nothing memorable. I forgot I ever played it, and that’s probably for the best.
After playing it for 2 hours, it’s already getting boring. And besides i don’t wanna ruin my mouse button playing this garbage mobile game.

very slow, very in your face with ads, it takes the worst elements of clicker heroes 1 and 2 and merges them into this turd.
Do you want a slow burn game that will take you years to play as a free user?
Do you want a game where you can whale away your money for only a tiny bit of progress?
Do you want the devs to have abandoned the game and left it on auto?
Then turn thumb downside up.; Otherwise, play Farmer Against Potatoes Idle.
Naah, this ain't it. It starts off well but at a certain point you hit a Paywall to progress... No thx, not for this sh1tty game

This game gets boring pretty quickly. It is just a basic clicker game where you have to click the screen over and over again, and there isn't much else to do. I really don't understand how some people can spend so many hours playing it, because it gets old fast.

You can't call a game a "beta" for ten years. I assume the development has been abandoned. Even the window size doesn't save when you change it!

The game could be fun and playable, but it clearly needs some bug fixes. The core mechanics are copied from "Clicker Heroes," while the screen design is from "Idle Champions of the Forgotten Realms." The graphics are good enough, but the interface needs improvement and more bug fixes.
it wont help for u, u must to pay upgrade more stuff?? HELL NO. COOL SCAMING COPYRIGHT FROM IDLE CHAMPIONS......

The fact that this game has a mandatory, unable to be disabled tutorial, even for returning players, means this game immediately gets a zero out of ten score for me, and not just deleted from my machine, but banned from it. In this day and age, not allowing people to disable tutorials is the height of bad design.

I like playing these P2W games sometimes to see how long I can play them before it becomes an unbearable slog-fest where you're supposed to start throwing money at the screen to progress reasonably.

It took 1 hour and 30 minutes. That's point I got stuck at 1 level, being forced to idle farm it for a long time to maybe be able to do the same with the next level, ad nauseam.
That is not supposed to be fun, by design.

This is where the developer hopes to have hooked you enough that you'll spend money on something to be able to pass levels again for a short while, until you spend money again... and again, and again, and again... You get the point.

In addition to the DLC here on the Steam store, the game is LITTERED with different microtransactions. TONS of different chests, currency types, generic scrolls and other misc. items, pets, paid buffs, characters, not to speak of those characte
The gameplay loop is really tiresome.
